name: QuestionnaireAssessment
description: Questionnaire Assessment objects are a means of gathering information from business users in the organization. Questionnaire Assessments are created when a Program is launched. Questionnaire Assessments are associated with underlying assets, the Program that launched it, and the Questionnaire Template it is based on.
